name: Cuyuna Cubing 2026
information:
This is the first ever competition in central Minnesota!

This competition is supported by the Midwest Cubing Association.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MzA3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5b8b44354f70adea6683f87f2a0f4a7efb67159d/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the Minnesota Cubing Community and follow the Midwest Cubing Assocation for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
